name: docx
description: DOCX is a scientific document output primitive for creating, reading, editing, validating, and rendering Word documents and templates. Use it for formal reports, manuscripts, memos, tables of contents, tracked changes, comments, and image-embedded office deliverables.
capabilities: Create and edit structured Word documents and templates.
Preserve headings, tables, lists, images, comments, and tracked-change semantics.
Render and validate the final document instead of trusting the source script alone.
requirements: LibreOffice or equivalent for rendering when visual inspection is required.
A source document, template, or structured content outline.
